verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs state that, beyond NVIDIA/AMD GPUs and CPUs, it supports 'diverse hardware plugins such as Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi', among others. This directly matches running inference on specialized accelerators through plugins, and the 'any model on any hardware' positioning reinforces it. The evidence, however, is a single feature-list line. missing for 10: detailed plugin installation/usage docs, per-accelerator feature or performance parity details, independent or hands-on corroboration of TPU/Gaudi inference.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support

citations.quote: Additionally, diverse hardware plugins such as Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi, IBM Spyre, Huawei Ascend, Rebellions NPU, Apple Silicon, MetaX GPU, and more.
Run any model on any hardware.
